verdict.summary: Cataloging remains a substantial RC working line with strong repository structure, documentation, Symfony 8/PHP 8.4 tooling, CI, static-analysis, test, readiness-report, security and observability surfaces. Fresh Console MCP reconnaissance confirms strict Composer validation and the changed-PHP syntax gate are green, while the current workspace contains a very large uncommitted migration: 340 status entries and a 252-file diff of approximately +697/-5303. The repository itself explicitly states that canon convergence is still transitional. The present tree therefore has good engineering depth but reduced RC confidence until the large migration receives full static/test/Gating/runtime acceptance.
strengths: Console MCP changed-PHP lint returned green across its 100-file tracked batch.
PHPStan is configured at level max for both src and tests.
PHPUnit, Panther and Playwright test surfaces are explicitly configured.
Repository provides extensive machine-readable RC, runtime, security, boundary, migration, idempotency and search readiness reports.
CI, OpenAPI contracts, Doctrine migrations, observability, security and canary surfaces are materially present.
RC diagnostic reports no hard blocker; its placeholder warning is a false positive against legitimate UI contract placeholder keys.
risks: Current workspace is heavily dirty: 340 status entries and 252 changed files, so HEAD alone does not represent the assessed implementation.
The active migration removes or relocates many services, interfaces, infrastructure classes and configuration files; full integration gates were not executed under this READ_ONLY task.
Repository documentation explicitly says the RC line is not yet final canon-clean and still carries mixed Category/Catalog compatibility vocabulary.
Managed Symfony runtime on 127.0.0.1:8000 was not running, so current browser-facing behavior was not verified.
Admin routes and UI links are being changed to /catalog/... paths; configured Playwright evidence exists but could not be regenerated without an execution path that may write test artifacts.
CI depends on Automater GitHub App credentials and sibling repository checkout, adding an external operational dependency.

Run schema:parity and the RC/readiness report suite against the current working tree.
